section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section is an addition to the maamar.
This section explains that a person who sins is worse than the nations of the world in their essential nature, who inherently recognize G-d's will.
section.t: What is written in the maamar "Basi LeGani" 5713, at the end of the paragraph,
that "the nations of the world and the klipos and the sitra achra do not transgress His will, blessed be He...
and a person who commits a transgression, who rebels against His will, blessed be He, is worse, etc." – its explanation is,
that one who commits a transgression is worse than the nations of the world as they are essentially, in their own right
that by the nature of creation, there must always be within them the recognition of "the G-d of gods,"
so that they would then be unable to transgress His will, blessed be He,
as Bilaam said, "I cannot transgress the word of the L-rd";

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section clarifies that nevertheless, by free choice, the nations can follow foolishness and violate the Seven Noachide Laws, as Bilaam did.
section.t: But certainly, regarding the matter of free choice, the nations of the world can also follow the spirit of foolishness and transgress the Seven Noachide Laws,
that due to the spirit of foolishness which covers and conceals,
there was within him the matter of "I have ventured"
which is one of the Seven Noachide Laws.
